messages.en:
{07 04 00}OMIGOSH!{01 00 00 0a 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}? {01 00 00 0a 00}Is it
really you? {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}?
This is so crazy!
{07 16 00}Do you know how many
months it's been since you
abandoned me? {01 00 00 0f 00}{04 12 00}!
{07 15 00}When you're not around,
{01 00 00 05 00}it's just total Dullsville
around here!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}OHJUMAL!{01 00 00 0a 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}? {01 00 00 0a 00}Kas see
oled tõesti sina? {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}?
See on nii hull!
{07 16 00}Kas tead, mitu kuud on
möödunud sellest, kui sa
mu hülgasid? {01 00 00 0f 00}{04 12 00}!
{07 15 00}Kui sind pole,
{01 00 00 05 00}on siin lihtsalt
täielik Igavusküla!

messages.en:
{07 02 00}Whaaaaat?{01 00 00 0a 00} Is that you,
{04 1f 00}?{01 01 00} {07 06 00}I'm in, like,
total shock, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}You've been missing for a
gazillion months! Well, OK,
it's only been {04 12 00}.
{07 06 00}I thought maybe you'd been
arrested for dining and
dashing or something.
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Miiiiis?{01 00 00 0a 00} Kas see oled sina,
{04 1f 00}?{01 01 00} {07 06 00}Olen, nagu,
täiesti šokis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}Sa oled kadunud olnud
miljon kuud! No olgu,
tegelikult {04 12 00}.
{07 06 00}Ma arvasin, et sind
vahistati söömise ja
põgenemise või millegi eest.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}How many months does it
take to forget someone's
face?{01 00 00 05 00} More than {04 12 00}, I bet!
{07 0e 00}But seriously, {01 00 00 05 00}I think I've
forgotten your name{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{01 00 00 05 00}Was it {04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Gotcha! {01 00 00 05 00}I'm just being silly!{01 01 00}
Of course I remember your
name, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Mitu kuud kulub, et
kellegi nägu ära
unustada?{01 00 00 05 00} Üle {04 12 00}, ma
pakun! {07 0e 00}Aga tõsiselt, {01 00 00 05 00}ma vist
olen su nime unustanud{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{01 00 00 05 00}Kas see oli {04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Sain kätte! {01 00 00 05 00}Ma teen nalja!{01 01 00}
Muidugi ma mäletan su
nime, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!

messages.en:
{07 02 00}WHOA!{01 00 00 0a 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 00 00}I went
on a {04 12 00}-month diet, {01 00 00 05 00}and
lost {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0d 00}five pounds!
But you weren't here, so{07 16 00} {01 00 00 05 00}I
gained it all back. {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 1b 00}Oh, well.
Diets are dumb.
messages.et:
{07 02 00}OHOO!{01 00 00 0a 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 00 00}Ma olin
{04 12 00} dieedil, {01 00 00 05 00}ja
